tnkloot.ponder.loot_basics.text_1: Adventure chests and hostile mobs can award sealed equipment. Ordinary materials remain ordinary loot.
tnkloot.ponder.loot_basics.text_2: The source level selects an equipment tier. Your TNK Progression milestone limits the roll; rarity is sealed when the drop is generated.
tnkloot.ponder.loot_basics.text_3: Weapons, ranged gear, armour, tools and accessories have separate pools. Dimension equipment retains its origin.
tnkloot.ponder.loot_basics.text_4: Boss crates use that boss's reward pool. Trophies, keys, ingredients and advancement rewards keep their original items.
tnkloot.ponder.loot_basics.text_5: Use the Identifier's Preview to inspect a drop. The Journal's Collection tracks your discoveries.
tnkloot.ponder.identifying.text_1: Right-click the Identifier. Place up to seven sealed drops into its input slots.
tnkloot.ponder.identifying.text_2: Preview lists eligible equipment and its chance. Looking at the pool does not consume or reroll your drop.
tnkloot.ponder.identifying.text_3: Read the batch price in vanilla XP points. Stored salvage credit reduces the amount you pay.
tnkloot.ponder.identifying.text_4: Confirm once to reveal the batch. The sealed tier, rarity and boss pool carry through to the result and its attributes.
tnkloot.ponder.identifying.text_5: Collect your equipment from the same slots. Closing or changing tabs returns any remaining items safely.
tnkloot.ponder.salvaging.text_1: Open Salvage from the Identifier. Use its seven input slots for unwanted identified equipment.
tnkloot.ponder.salvaging.text_2: Check the XP fee and the credit you will receive. Your inputs remain intact during review.
tnkloot.ponder.salvaging.text_3: Press Review, then confirm Salvage. The final action destroys the reviewed equipment and charges the displayed fee.
tnkloot.ponder.salvaging.text_4: Salvage grants stored identification credit. It pays part of a future identification; it does not grant XP or character levels.
tnkloot.ponder.salvaging.text_5: Changed inputs require a new review. Close the screen before confirming to take your equipment back.
tnkloot.ponder.mechanical_identifying.te: The Mechanical Identifier uses Liquid XP to reveal equipment. The Identifier itself needs no rotational power.
Feed sealed drops from above or an ordinary side. The hopper points straight into the seven input slots.
Supply supported Liquid XP at the right-side port. The right side follows the machine's facing; the tank holds 4,000 mB by default.
Your fluid network must pump XP into this port. Each item costs its normal identification fee converted to fluid and takes 40 ticks by default.
Extract revealed equipment underneath. This hopper faces the output depot; sealed rarity, tier and boss rewards are preserved.
Right-click to inspect the machine. Missing XP or full outputs pause processing while keeping your items safe.
